rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for referring to what happened after that time or event.

example.english: The meeting ended, and everyone went home thereafter.
example.traditional: 嗰次會議之後，大家就散會返屋企喇。
example.jyutping: go2 ci3 wui6 ji5 zi1 hau6 daai6 gaa1 zau6 saan3 wui2 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that the situation continued from that point onward.

example.english: I had an accident and thereafter didn't dare drive again.
example.traditional: 嗰次意外之後，我由嗰時開始就唔敢再揸車喇。
example.jyutping: go2 ci3 ji3 ngoi6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 jau4 go2 si4 hoi1 ci2 zau6 m4 gam2 zoi3 zaa1 ce1 laa3
